changelog: 🚀 DeepSeek Harness & Mobile-Harness Unified Integration: Seamlessly combined the Mobile-Harness architecture into JIN while fully preserving ARM performance, Antigravity 2.0, Termux subsystem, 100 Tools suite, and Google Drive Cloud Vault.

📱 4 Dedicated APK Release Flavors: Distributed separate production APKs for both JIN Standard and JIN Termux in both Online and Offline editions (jin-standard-online, jin-standard-offline, jin-termux-online, jin-termux-offline).
🤖 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Engine: Direct headless execution bridge with local reasoning streams ('dsh: reasoning:'), API provider abstraction, and autonomous tool invocation.

📦 Modular Runtime Bundle Manager: High-performance Zstandard (.tar.zst) archive decompressor supporting on-demand and offline modular bundles (Core Ubuntu 20.04 ARM64, DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Python 3, Android SDK 36/JDK 17, and Antigravity CLI).
🔄 Workspace Checkpoints & Diff Engine: Real-time file change tracker computing line additions, deletions, and context blocks with per-file Undo/Keep and baseline rollback.
🛠️ On-Device Android App Compilation: In-app Android project scaffolding (Jetpack Compose & Kotlin/XML) and direct build pipeline with instant APK installation via Android PackageInstaller session.
🌐 OpenRouter Routing Gateway & Local Format Adapter: Loopback HTTP proxy on 127.0.0.1 providing provider routing order with automatic fallbacks and Anthropic-to-OpenAI translation.
✨ 100% Scrubbed & Rebranded: Fully cleaned of all third-party branding and attributed exclusively to Samir Ahmmed.
